messages.subject: Online ggplot2 course
parts:
Hi all,

If you're interested in taking a ggplot2 course, I'm going to be
offering an online course through statistics.com,
http://www.statistics.com/ourcourses/ggplot2. Most of the material
I'll be covering is available online for free, but there are a few
advantages to taking the course:

* A structured setting of readings, video watching and exercises
* Graded assignments
* A monetary incentive to study!
* Formal recognition for your progress

Please let me know if you have any questions.

Regards,

Hadley

--
Assistant Professor / Dobelman Family Junior Chair
Department of Statistics / Rice University
http://had.co.nz/
